Parking the roadmap: 1 of 2 stages complete. The re-rank question I asked last turn no longer needs an answer, because O2 is not promoted.

**What parking does (§5):**

1. **Append the unfinished work to `specs/deferred_items.md`**, one item each, under `## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06`:
   - **Stage 2: Closure notices (O5, Track B).** Size: small, one closure-log poll every 10 minutes. Done when: the notice job and its operator mailing list exist, and in a test an email reaches every address on the list within an hour of a new closure entry. Text-message notices stay out, as before.
   - **O2: 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock.** Size: small, one model run a day on Stage 1's fit, which took 22 min. Done when: each lock has a 7-day closure-risk outlook built from the river-level forecast.
   - **O3: Separate closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled.** Size: about 14× Stage 1's 1.8 GB. That is roughly 25 GB and several hours of fitting if fit time scales linearly. Done when: each of the 14 locks has its own closure curve from a pooled fit.
   - **O4: Closure-history map for boat operators.** Size: about a day, one static map page. Done when: operators can view a closure-history map of the canal.

   Each item will be self-contained and point to `specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md`. That file stays where it is: the curve rises steeply above 3.1 m, and the four longest-record locks show nearly the same curve.

2. **Move the roadmap** to `specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md` and mark it at the top: `PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete`. There's no synthesized spec, methodology or critique file to retire alongside it, because the source was your own words.

3. **Commit** both changes on `main`.

**First tool calls**, to match the backlog's item schema and check that the file exists before appending:

```
Glob  ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/**/*deferred*
Read  <the deferred-backlog reference found above>
Read  specs/deferred_items.md        # may not exist yet; if so, create it
```

After that:

```
Edit  specs/deferred_items.md        # append the dated section with the 4 items, fitted to the schema
Bash  mkdir -p specs/completed && git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
Edit  specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md   # add the PARKED line under the title
Bash  git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md && git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap (1 of 2 stages complete); defer Stage 2, O2–O4"
```

One small check: the session date is 2026-11-06, but the environment clock reads 2026-11-10. I'll date the park 2026-11-06 unless you say otherwise.
